synthesis: Scout drivers see only their own map (ClarityScoutMapController scoped to $user->kit_id + assigned zones); that self-scoping STAYS for metrics and hits. In shared zones, multiple drivers over-grid the same streets because they cannot see where a teammate already drove. DEV-2199 adds an opt-in, config-gated (OFF by default), DRIVER-ONLY Map Layers toggle that overlays OTHER org drivers' historical driven lines for today + last 7 days, in a single distinct color (cyan), snapshot-refreshed (<=15-min MV, NOT live-polled), geographically limited to the current map viewport (existing DEV-2185 bbox + zoom>=12 gate). It EXCLUDES teammate metrics, teammate live hits/hits-pending-repo, real-time position dots, and per-teammate attribution. Net work = re-scope the existing org-wide Bird's-Eye reader (DEV-2116/2182 org kit set + KitScanPathsQuery) down to the driver-authenticated map behind a global feature flag, and render a new PathLayer under the DEV-2185 guardrails. STAGING ONLY. QA: Yolanda. Scope + all open questions resolved via a human interview with Dalton (2026-07-20).

scope.summary: (1) Global feature flag: add a config value (from env CLARITY_SCOUT_TEAMMATE_OVERLAY_ENABLED, default false) — a single global gate, NOT a per-org org_meta flag (Dalton-decided; see AC-1 deviation). Default false = prod-safe; staging turns it on. (2) Surface it via ClarityScoutAuthController::me() (mirrors trips_enabled) -> authStore.teammateOverlayEnabled. (3) New driver endpoint ClarityScoutMapController::teammatePaths(): 403/empty if the flag is off; resolve the driver's ORG Scout kit set (Bird's-Eye orgScoutKits/getKits pattern, DEV-2182), EXCLUDE the driver's own kit, and call KitScanPathsQuery(org_id, kit_ids=orgKitsMinusSelf, range=last_7, bbox=the client viewport bounds). Return a flat single-color path payload; degrade gracefully (empty + Log::warning) on CH failure. (4) New Map Layers toggle in DashboardOverlay.vue (gated on the flag AND !adminMode) + a dedicated deck.gl cyan #0891B2 PathLayer in ScannerMap.vue gated by pathLayersEligible() (zoom>=12) + !adminMode. Metrics/hits untouched. LINES ONLY (no static position dots) for v1.

questions.q: Which query class powers the overlay (ticket suggested OrgLivePathsQuery)?
questions.answer: KitScanPathsQuery (clarity.kit_scan_paths, <=15-min ReplacingMergeTree MV, FINAL) — NOT OrgLivePathsQuery/OrgLivePositionsQuery. All 3 blind candidates independently verified the OrgLive* classes are live 3s-cursor readers over raw sc_positions with NO bbox (unbounded over 7d multi-driver + conflicts with AC-5), while KitScanPathsQuery already supports org_id+kit_ids+range+bbox and is the same class Bird's-Eye historical scanPaths() uses. The ticket reuse table was a trap.

questions.q: Can platform gate/write this without Backyard/CDC?
questions.answer: Yes — resolved further by Dalton choosing a global CONFIG flag (env, read via config()), so no org_meta write is even needed. (Aside: platform CAN write org_meta directly via updateProperties, but that path is now out of scope.)

questions.q: MATERIAL: What does 'within the driver's zone' mean mechanically?
questions.answer: Org-wide kit set + viewport bbox (Dalton 2026-07-20). Include ALL org Scout kits' paths (Bird's-Eye set, minus the driver's own kit) geographically limited by the client VIEWPORT bounding box (the existing DEV-2185 bbox mechanism) + zoom>=12. NOT zone-assignment membership (would miss a teammate driving through an unassigned zone) and NOT an exact polygon clip. The driver operating in their zone at zoom>=12 naturally sees org coverage in view.
